name: Eros Sector
source:
A young man fleeing a traumatic event seeks to create a new life for himself far from home. His journey has brought him to Eros sector, where the rule of law is determined by which corporation can enforce it, and the core governments are a far off afterthought.
He finds himself looking for work on the independent starship Boudica, whose eccentric female crew is used to working in this grey area, and doing whatever it takes to get the job done.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/DelinquentProductions]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻男人为了逃离创伤，远走他乡，试图重新开始人生。旅途将他带到了厄洛斯星区。在这里，谁能强制执行法律，谁就有权制定规则，而核心星域的政府，早已遥不可及，无人顾念。
他来到独立星舰“布狄卡”号上找工作。船上性格古怪的女船员们，早已习惯在这片灰色地带谋生，为了完成任务不择手段。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/DelinquentProductions]Patreon[/url]]
